scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Private Sector Organisation In Promoting The Wellbeing And Welfare Of Senior Citizens
other_conditions: The nominee must be a private sector organization that works for the welfare of senior citizens

Activities must address problems of the elderly by providing gainful employment, utilising skills and experience for societal benefit, creating infrastructure in geriatric medical care, making arrangements for care of former (superannuated) employees, and providing barrier‑free workplaces
The organization's activities for senior citizens should be away from its mainline business
The nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized nominating agency or individual
The award is open to all Indian institutions, organisations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, memento, cash award and travel, lodging and per‑diem expenses for themselves and one companion, all reimbursed by the Central Government.
